tools.name: code_parse_ast
tools.description: Parses a single source file and returns AST symbol and edge extraction payload.

tools.name: code_read_file
tools.description: Fetches raw source text or a line-range snippet for a target file path.

tools.name: code_render_graph
tools.description: Renders a filtered topology graph export payload by module path and max call depth.

tools.name: code_blast_radius
tools.description: Performs BFS caller-depth search for a target qualified symbol name. Returns all callers up to max_depth.

tools.name: code_find_callers
tools.description: Returns all direct caller symbols of a given qualified function name.

tools.name: code_find_dead_code
tools.description: Scans the code graph and returns all private, non-test, non-entrypoint symbols with zero fan-in (unreferenced dead code).

tools.name: code_find_god_functions
tools.description: Returns functions exceeding configurable thresholds for lines-of-code, cyclomatic complexity, or parameter count.

tools.name: code_check_contract_drift
tools.description: Verifies AST symbol signatures against HBP contract schemas and reports any drift.
